run_mrp_subscriber_bob: run the MR subscriber that listens on from/alice and echoes messages back via from/bob
create_mrp_publisher: create an a0 Publisher on a topic like from/bob for publishing packets
create_mrp_subscriber: create an a0 Subscriber on a topic like from/alice with a callback function
create_mrp_packet_with_dependency: create an a0 Packet with a dependency list and payload string
review_mrp_callback: review the callback function that publishes a dependent packet with the received payload
